description: Provenance registry for every dataset used by the Silent Dropout Detection System.

sources.source_name: AISHE (All India Survey on Higher Education)
sources.dataset_description: Higher-education enrolment, faculty, infrastructure and exam-result statistics for Indian institutions, with West Bengal extracts.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (repository-level metadata may restrict redistribution; record the exact license per downloaded file)
sources.notes: Official source. Automated download of the interactive dashboard may be blocked; manual download procedure documented in reports/manual_download.md if blocked.

sources.source_name: West Bengal State Council of Higher Education (WBSCHE)
sources.dataset_description: University/college-wise academic data, teaching-learning information, placement statistics and five-year institutional datasets
sources.license: Proprietary institutional data; check per file
sources.notes: Often available as PDFs/reports rather than machine-readable CSVs; document manual acquisition if no structured file is public.

sources.dataset_description: Digitally archived academic documents; public aggregate statistics only
sources.notes: No individual student records may be accessed; use only public aggregate statistics.

sources.dataset_description: University/college-wise enrolment, academic-year trends and course-wise student statistics
sources.license: Check individual dataset license before use
sources.notes: Check per-dataset licensing and download availability before building on it.

sources.dataset_description: Genuine anonymized international higher-education records: studentInfo, studentAssessment, studentRegistration, studentVle, assessments, vle, courses.
sources.notes: Use as a research benchmark only, NEVER as West Bengal student data. Document its withdrawal/outcome definition and the limitation that precise withdrawal dates are not always recoverable.

sources.dataset_description: University dropout dataset with provenance records, data dictionary and target definitions
sources.notes: Use as an external comparison dataset if appropriate.

sources.dataset_description: Locally generated demonstration records used only for development, UI wiring and pipeline tests.
sources.notes: Never shown in the real-data dashboard without a visible 'synthetic' label. Not research evidence.
